ADD_IMAGE_LAYERS: Add images (Ctrl+I), or drop image files on the window
ADD_SHAPE_LAYER: Add a shape layer (Ctrl+R adds the kind added last)
ASPECT_RATIO_LOCKED: Aspect ratio locked: width and height change together. Click to unlock.
ASPECT_RATIO_UNLOCKED: Aspect ratio unlocked: width and height change separately. Click to lock.
CANNOT_ALLOCATE_GROUP_BUFFER: Cannot allocate a {w} x {h} group buffer
CANNOT_APPLY_EFFECTS: Cannot apply the effects of a layer
CONFIRM_SAVE_BEFORE_CLOSING: Save the changes to "{name}" before closing?
CUT_PREVIEW_OPACITY_HINT: Below 1, what will be cut stays faintly visible on the canvas. The export always leaves it blank.
DISTORT_LAYER_HINT:
On: drag each corner on its own to fake perspective.
Off: corners resize the image.
Holding Ctrl while dragging a corner swaps the two.
DRAW_LINE_HINT: Click to place both ends of the line, or press and drag to curve it. Esc to cancel.
DRAW_POINTS_HINT: Click to place a sharp point, or press and drag for a smooth one; a click on the first point closes the shape. Double-click, Enter or right-click to finish.
EDIT_POINTS_HINT: Drag the points on the canvas, and the handles of the picked point to curve its segments (Alt moves one handle on its own). Double-click a point to make it smooth or sharp, a segment to add a point there. Del removes the picked point and the arrow keys move it. Shift keeps 15° steps; Alt stops snapping. A double click on the shape also starts editing; Esc stops.
EFFECTS_INTRO: Effects change how the image looks without changing its file.
EFFECTS_ORDER_HINT: Applied top to bottom. Drag the dots to reorder.
EFFECT_BRIGHTNESS_CONTRAST_HINT: Lighten or darken, and increase or reduce contrast
EFFECT_DROP_SHADOW_HINT: A soft shadow cast behind the image, outside its edges too
EFFECT_HUE_SATURATION_HINT: Shift colors around the color wheel and change their intensity
EFFECT_OUTLINE_HINT: A line along the edge of the image's shape: its visible pixels
EFFECT_POSTERIZE_HINT: Reduce each channel to a few levels
EFFECT_TINT_HINT: Color the image with one color
ELEMENT_LINE_COLOR: Line color, on screen and in the export
FILTER_LINKED_JSON_PROJECT: Linked JSON project, images as separate files
FOLLOW_SYSTEM_THEME_HINT: Follow the operating system's light or dark setting
FONTS_NOT_INSTALLED:
These fonts are not installed, so their text is shown with the built-in font:
{fonts}
GROUP_LAYERS: Group: put the selection in a new group, or add an empty group (Ctrl+G)
GROUP_OPACITY_HINT: Applied to the group as a whole
IMAGES_NOT_LOADED:
These images could not be loaded:
{files}
MISSING_EFFECT_HINT:
"{id}" is not available: its plugin may not be installed.
It is kept in the project but not applied.
MOVE_GROUP_HINT: Drag on the canvas inside the group to move it, or use the arrow keys.
MOVE_LAYER_TO_BOTTOM: Send to the bottom of its group
MOVE_LAYER_TO_TOP: Bring to the top of its group
NO_LAYERS_YET: No layers yet. Click Add… or drop images here.
NO_LAYER_SELECTED: Select a layer to edit it.
NO_TEMPLATES_FOUND: No controller templates found. Put a folder containing a .dxf file in a "templates" folder next to the program.
PREVIEW_CUTS_HINT: Cover what the export leaves blank: outside the outline and inside holes
RESCAN_TEMPLATES_HINT: Look again for templates added, changed or removed
RESET_LAYER_TRANSFORM_HINT: Fit inside the page, no rotation
SAVED_WITH_MISSING_IMAGES:
Saved, but the image files of these layers are missing, so the saved project can't show them:
{layers}
SAVE_TEMPLATE_PLACEMENT_HINT: Write this placement into the template's template.json
SHAPE_EFFECT_SIZE_HINT: On the page; resizing the shape keeps it
SHAPE_INNER_RADIUS_HINT: Distance of the inner corners from the center, as a share of the points' distance
SHAPE_STROKE_WIDTH_HINT: Width of the line along the outline, centered on it; resizing the shape keeps it
SHOW_ELEMENT_LINES: Show its lines on the canvas
SNAP_TO_ANCHORS_HINT: Image centers and corners snap to the template's anchors while dragged. Hold Alt to drag freely.
TEMPLATE_DOES_NOT_FIT: Template does not fit on this page
TEXT_EFFECT_SIZE_HINT: On the page; it follows the font size
TEXT_FALLBACK_FONTS_HINT: Characters the font lacks are taken from these fonts, saved with the project like the font itself.
TEXT_FONT_NOT_INSTALLED: This font is not installed: the text is shown with the built-in font.
TEXT_FONT_SIZE_HINT: Height of the letters; scaling the layer changes it
TEXT_LETTER_SPACING_HINT: In thousandths of the font size
TEXT_LINE_SPACING_HINT: Distance between lines, in font sizes
TEXT_MISSING_CHARACTERS: No installed font has these characters: {chars}
TEXT_ON_PATH_TYPE_HINT: Text on a path is typed here, not on the canvas.
TEXT_OUTLINE_HINT: Thickness of the line around the letters
TEXT_PATH_BEND_HINT: How much the lines bend: at 100 % the first line makes a whole circle; below 0 they bend down
TEXT_PATH_FLIP_HINT: Put the text on the other side of the path, running the other way: inside a circle, readable at its bottom
TEXT_PATH_POSITION_HINT: Where the text stands on the path, from its start (the top of a circle), as a share of its length. The text's alignment says which part of it stands there.
TEXT_PATH_RADIUS_HINT: Radius of the circle the first line's baseline follows. The layer is centered on the circle: snap its center to a button's anchor to put the text around the button.
TEXT_PATH_SHIFT_HINT: Distance from the path to the baseline, towards the top of the letters
TYPE_ON_CANVAS_HINT: Or double-click the text on the canvas to type it there.
UNSAVED_CHANGES_WARNING: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
